agency_lifecycle_stats.label: Time to final rule by agency
agency_lifecycle_stats.summary: Estimates how the chance of a final rule changes with time after a proposal. The calculation includes rules still open and those withdrawn.
agency_lifecycle_stats.scope: Pools all proposal years in the collected docketed proceedings. Agencies remain separate, without combining them into parent departments; groups with fewer than 30 rules are omitted.
gaps: Source upload dates can differ from action dates.
One rule can span several dockets, so these are not counts of distinct rulemakings.

agency_monthly_volume.label: Agency monthly document counts
agency_monthly_volume.summary: Counts collected Regulations.gov documents by agency, month and document type. Known removed postings and documents with missing or year-zero dates are excluded.
agency_monthly_volume.scope: Covers the collected document table, not all agency activity. Other source dates remain unchanged, including dates before 1990 and dates in the future.

agency_stats.label: Agency totals
agency_stats.summary: Totals collected dockets, documents and public comments for each agency. Known removed postings and their comments are excluded.
agency_stats.scope: Covers the records in the docket, document and comment tables; it adds no source records.
gaps: Missing source records also leave gaps in these totals.

agenda_item_proceedings.label: Planned actions linked to proceedings
agenda_item_proceedings.summary: Connects planned regulatory actions to proceedings using regulation identifiers explicitly stated in docket, document or Federal Register records.
agenda_item_proceedings.scope: Includes links supported by the collected source records.
gaps: A shared regulation identifier alone does not establish that two records concern the same action.

amendments.label: Amendments
amendments.summary: Lists amendments from Congress.gov, including sponsors and the bill or amendment each would change. Updates combine newly fetched records with earlier captures.
amendments.scope: The reviewed collection covers the 119th Congress, with detailed records for each amendment.
gaps: Older Congresses are outside the reviewed coverage.
Repeated source entries can hide omissions; page counts alone cannot prove completeness.
Some House amendments name the Rules Committee rather than a member sponsor.

bill_actions.label: Bill actions
bill_actions.summary: Lists actions recorded in GovInfo’s bill-status files and derives each bill’s legislative stage from those actions.
bill_actions.scope: Bills read from the 108th Congress onward. Coverage varies by Congress, and earlier captures remain until refreshed.
gaps: Different systems can record the same event. Row counts count entries, not distinct events.
Filtering by one source or action code can omit unique events.
A bill with no action rows may be unread; it is not necessarily inactive.

bill_committee_actions.label: Bill actions in committee reports
bill_committee_actions.summary: Interprets bill actions described in committee activity reports. Official committee rosters help identify committee names.
bill_committee_actions.scope: Actions found in the activity reports we have read, using supported wording patterns.
gaps: Automated readings can attach the wrong action or bill, especially in sentences naming several bills.
Many actions are missed, so counts understate activity.
Extracted dates have not been verified as dates of the actions.

bill_committee_activities.label: Committee activity on bills
bill_committee_activities.summary: Lists what committees and subcommittees did on each bill, and when, from GovInfo’s bill-status files.
bill_committee_activities.scope: Bills reread for committee activities from the 108th Congress onward. Regular updates cover the sitting Congress; older Congresses require separate collection runs.
gaps: Earlier bill captures may lack these rows until reread; absence does not prove no committee action.
Repeated source entries remain, so row totals may exceed distinct actions.
Some activities have no stated date.

bill_committees.label: Bill committee referrals
bill_committees.summary: Lists committees and subcommittees named in GovInfo’s bill-status files, including their relationship to each bill.
bill_committees.scope: Bills read from the 108th Congress onward. Older captures remain until their Congress is refreshed.
gaps: Coverage varies by Congress.
A missing committee relationship may reflect an unread bill.

bill_cosponsors.label: Bill cosponsors
bill_cosponsors.summary: Lists cosponsors from GovInfo’s bill-status files, including sponsorship and withdrawal dates when the source provides them.
bill_cosponsors.scope: Bills reread for cosponsor details from the 108th Congress onward. Some Congresses still await that reread.
gaps: A bill with no cosponsor rows may be unread, rather than have no cosponsors.

bill_family_archives.label: Bill archive download checks
bill_family_archives.summary: Records GovInfo bill-status archive listings, including dates and sizes used to detect changes and avoid downloading unchanged files.
bill_family_archives.scope: One record per listed archive folder, identified by Congress and bill type.
gaps: Listing an archive does not prove every bill inside was read successfully.
These are collection records, not a census of bills.

bill_family_backfill_walks.label: Historical bill collection progress
bill_family_backfill_walks.summary: Compares the number of bills Congress.gov reports with the number reached while collecting older Congresses. Retained progress lets collection resume later.
bill_family_backfill_walks.scope: One record per Congress and bill type reached in the 82nd–107th Congresses.
gaps: An unvisited Congress has no progress record; that does not mean it has no bills.
Duplicate list entries can hide missing bills, even when the listed counts agree.
Completed lists are not routinely rechecked; individual bill details can still be missing.

bill_family_backfills.label: Historical bill read outcomes
bill_family_backfills.summary: Records whether each attempted historical bill detail was successfully read. Later runs resume from these outcomes.
gaps: Bills not yet attempted have no row.
A successful detail read does not include every action, committee record or text version.

bill_publisher_summaries.label: Congressional Research Service bill summaries
bill_publisher_summaries.summary: Contains bill summaries written by the Congressional Research Service and distributed in GovInfo’s bill-status files.
bill_publisher_summaries.scope: Summaries available for bills read from the 108th Congress onward, with coverage varying by Congress.
gaps: These are publisher-written summaries; the separate AI summary table serves a different purpose.
An absent summary may be unwritten or not yet collected.

bill_sections.label: Bill text sections
bill_sections.summary: Splits acquired bill text into sections. Text comes from GovInfo bulk downloads or individual document requests; earlier sections remain until refreshed.
bill_sections.scope: Sections from bill versions whose full text was downloaded and successfully read.
gaps: Undownloaded, unreadable or PDF-only printings can have no section rows.
Missing sections do not establish that a bill has no published text.

bill_subjects.label: Bill policy areas and subjects
bill_subjects.summary: Combines subject assignments already held with bill records, GovInfo bulk bill-status files, and Congress.gov detail requests.
bill_subjects.scope: Bulk files cover the 108th Congress onward; Congress.gov requests cover the 93rd–107th and cases the bulk reader cannot read.
gaps: Collection grows in bounded runs and is not a complete subject census.
An empty assignment can mean no subjects were assigned or the source did not hold that bill.
Some answers are collected once and can become outdated.

bill_summaries.label: AI bill summaries
bill_summaries.summary: Reserved for AI-generated summaries of acquired bill text. Automatic updates currently leave this feature disabled.
bill_summaries.scope: Intentionally empty under the current processing policy.
gaps: Official Congressional Research Service summaries appear in a separate table.

bill_versions.label: Bill versions and printings
bill_versions.summary: Combines GovInfo’s list of bill printings with downloaded text. Bulk downloads supply text from the 113th Congress onward; individual requests fill earlier or missing printings.
bill_versions.scope: Listed printings for bills read from the 108th Congress onward. Coverage includes both downloaded text and listings whose text remains pending.
gaps: A version row does not prove its text was downloaded or read successfully.
Some law printings retain only publisher links, labels and dates.
Earlier captures remain when a new download fails or is deferred.

bill_vote_references.label: Votes referenced by bills
bill_vote_references.summary: Lists roll-call votes explicitly named in bill actions from GovInfo’s bill-status files.
bill_vote_references.scope: References from bills read from the 108th Congress onward, with earlier captures retained until refreshed.
gaps: The same vote can appear in several actions or captures; count distinct vote identities, not rows.
This is not a complete list of chamber votes. A missing reference may reflect an unread bill.

budget_volumes.label: President’s budget volumes
budget_volumes.summary: Collects supported budget volumes from GovInfo and reads their main PDFs. Previously collected volumes remain available as new ones are added.
budget_volumes.scope: Selected volumes issued from January 1, 2023 onward, limited to supported types with a main PDF. Citation counts cover only pages read.
gaps: Volumes without a main PDF are excluded, even when separate component PDFs or spreadsheets are available.
Printed bill numbers omit their Congress, so they cannot directly identify a bill.
Budget fiscal year and publication year are different.

cbo_cost_estimates.label: Congressional Budget Office estimate index
cbo_cost_estimates.summary: Combines estimate listings in GovInfo’s bill-status files with Congressional Budget Office publication feeds. GovInfo’s entry takes precedence when both identify the same bill and estimate.
cbo_cost_estimates.scope: Collected bills from the 108th Congress onward. Estimates for the 112th and 113th rely on feeds because the bill-status files omit them.
gaps: Estimate documents are not downloaded. Grouped estimates and items without bill links appear only in the feed-items table.
Publisher bill identifiers can be wrong. A report citation does not prove it contains that estimate.
Missing estimates or earliest matches do not establish a bill’s complete estimate history.

cbo_feed_items.label: Congressional Budget Office feed items
cbo_feed_items.summary: Lists every item in each successfully read Congressional Budget Office cost-estimate feed, including publications that name no bill.
cbo_feed_items.scope: Feeds read from the 108th Congress onward. Regular updates cover the sitting Congress; older Congresses require separate collection runs.
gaps: A failed feed read leaves its earlier capture in place.
Feed contents do not establish a complete history or include the estimate documents.
An item without a bill name may identify bills only inside its undownloaded document.

cfr_sections.label: Annual regulation index
cfr_sections.summary: Indexes annual regulatory sections, appendices and other structural units from GovInfo, using volume text to identify their parts.
cfr_sections.scope: Covers the 2025 annual edition and some 2026 titles. This index does not contain full regulatory text or the continuously updated electronic code.
gaps: Edition coverage varies by title.
Some retained records may predate corrections to their placement within a part.

comment_attributes.label: Comment details
comment_attributes.summary: Copies additional fields from Regulations.gov comment records collected through Mirrulations. Full rereads and later updates fill fields missing from earlier versions.
comment_attributes.scope: Covers comments listed in the collection, not an independent census of all comments on Regulations.gov.
gaps: Fields absent from the source remain blank.

comment_periods.label: Derived submission-date windows
comment_periods.summary: Combines Federal Register and Regulations.gov dates into possible submission windows. Explicitly named extensions are joined; reopenings remain separate.
comment_periods.scope: Covers collected records with usable dates. Windows that close before opening, placeholder future deadlines and certain older records without opening or posting dates are excluded.
gaps: These are not official deadlines: dates can concern comments, objections, hearings or petitions.
Sources can disagree; the latest grouped date does not settle the deadline. Read the notice and later amendments.
Some extensions and duplicate notices remain separate; a missing date does not mean no deadline exists.

comments.label: Public comments
comments.summary: Collects Regulations.gov comments through Mirrulations, combining earlier records with later updates. Text may come from the mirror or selected attachment extraction.
comments.scope: Reported date coverage starts in 1990, but raw records retain older and invalid dates. Dates describe posting, not receipt.
gaps: Comments on removed postings remain; moved or reposted comments can appear more than once.
Blank text or fields can reflect incomplete extraction or older reads, not absence in the source.

comments_index.label: Public comment counts
comments_index.summary: Counts the collected public comments by agency, docket and posting month.
comments_index.scope: Covers the same comments as the public comments table. Months reflect posting dates, not receipt dates.
gaps: Includes comments on removed postings and possible reposted duplicates; agency and docket summaries exclude known removed postings.

committee_assignments.label: Committee assignments
committee_assignments.summary: Reads occupied committee assignments from official House Clerk and Senate roster files. Each successful chamber update replaces its current-Congress assignments.
committee_assignments.scope: Current-Congress roster captures and the last retained capture for any earlier Congress; this is not a daily membership history.
gaps: Vacancies and placeholder seats have no assignment row.
Some committee identifiers do not match the committee directory.
A failed roster read can leave one chamber’s assignments older than the other’s.

committee_meetings.label: Committee meetings
committee_meetings.summary: Combines Congress.gov meeting listings with separately fetched meeting details. Earlier captures remain while new or changed records are collected.
committee_meetings.scope: Current and previous Congresses, with up to 1,000 detail reads per run; some rows still contain only listing fields.
gaps: Sources can omit committees and related bills. Linked documents are not downloaded.
Senate records do not supply witnesses here; an empty list does not mean nobody testified.
Meeting dates and status can lag rescheduling.

committee_report_reads.label: Report and hearing read outcomes
committee_report_reads.summary: Records the outcome of each selected report or hearing read, including successful reads that found no bill links.
committee_report_reads.scope: Selected GovInfo reports and hearings that the collector attempted to read.
gaps: A completed read applies to that document and reading method, not the entire source archive.
No bill links can be a valid result of a successful read.

committee_reports.label: Committee reports
committee_reports.summary: Collects selected GovInfo committee reports and their parts. It records the publisher’s primary bill and separately interprets text describing or containing Congressional Budget Office estimate letters.
committee_reports.scope: A growing selection across multiple Congresses. Accepted report parts are separate rows; older records may await rereading into parts.
gaps: Historical and separately published component coverage is incomplete.
A report saying it contains an estimate does not prove the letter was extracted.
Oversized or unreadable documents may retain an earlier capture.

committees.label: Committees
committees.summary: Combines Congress.gov’s committee directory with separate detail records. The directory covers all Congresses the service lists.
committees.scope: Since September 26, 2026, collection reads the unrestricted directory, including historical committees. Filter for current committees when needed.
gaps: Directory presence does not establish that detailed committee history was collected.
The source can serve fewer committees than its declared count.
Some details remain from earlier captures.

congress_bills.label: Congressional bills
congress_bills.summary: Combines a retained historical bill index, GovInfo bulk bill-status files, Congress.gov detail requests, and citations from the laws table. Individual fields can retain values from different collection dates.
congress_bills.scope: The index includes actions dated as early as December 16, 1799. Bulk enrichment starts at the 108th Congress; older detail collection covers the 82nd–107th.
gaps: Historical detail varies; older collection omits action, committee and text subrecords.
Some 118th-Congress House and Senate bills may retain incorrect zero cosponsor counts until reread.
Source labels do not identify every field’s origin; update dates and legislative stages can retain older values.

court_citation_map.label: Which opinions cite which
court_citation_map.summary: Links citing and cited opinions using CourtListener’s automated citation matching. The depth value counts mentions.
court_citation_map.scope: Includes the complete June 30, 2026 citation-map export, not every citation in published court opinions.
gaps: Unresolved citations are absent, some opinion links are unmatched, and links to recent decisions can arrive late.
Mentions do not show whether a court followed, distinguished or overruled a decision.
Several opinion records can represent one decision; rows are not distinct decisions.

court_citations.label: Court reporter citations
court_citations.summary: Lists the reporter references CourtListener attaches to each decision, preserving its reporter abbreviations.
court_citations.scope: Includes the complete June 30, 2026 citations export.
gaps: Missing references may still appear in printed opinions; this export has no Supreme Court Reporter citations in volumes 143 or 144.
Some references lack a matching decision record because export times differ or CourtListener merged records.

court_docket_groups.label: Possible duplicate court dockets
court_docket_groups.summary: Groups collected CourtListener docket records that appear to describe the same case, using court, docket number and other case details.
court_docket_groups.scope: Checks repeated docket numbers among the selected dockets present in the source edition.
gaps: Groups are inferred, not official case identities; courts can reuse docket numbers.
Missing case identifiers, differing case names or records newer than the source edition can leave dockets ungrouped.

court_dockets.label: Agency-challenge court dockets
court_dockets.summary: Combines CourtListener search results, bulk docket records and earlier collected records for Administrative Procedure Act suits.
court_dockets.scope: Covers dockets filed from 1992 onward under nature-of-suit code 899, mainly in district courts.
gaps: This selection does not cover all agency litigation, including many appeals-court petitions.
Some party names are missing, and several docket records can describe one case.
Names alone do not confirm a link to an agency or regulatory action.

court_opinion_clusters.label: Court decisions and opinion groups
court_opinion_clusters.summary: Combines CourtListener’s June 30, 2026 decision-group export with later search additions. Related docket records supply court details.
court_opinion_clusters.scope: Includes the complete export; later search results contain fewer fields. Opinion text is separate.
gaps: Several groups can represent one decision; count neither groups nor opinion rows as distinct decisions.
Later trial-court records and corrections to exported records wait for the next export.
The source lacks unpublished D.C. Circuit decisions from April 2001 through July 2020.

court_opinion_pdf_extractions.label: Selected court opinion PDF text
court_opinion_pdf_extractions.summary: Extracts text from selected court opinion PDFs, checking each downloaded file against CourtListener’s recorded file.
court_opinion_pdf_extractions.scope: Covers one selected group of PDFs, not the full opinion index. Different file versions remain separate.
gaps: This extracted text is separate from CourtListener’s own text fields.
An absent opinion does not mean its PDF or text is unavailable elsewhere.

court_opinions.label: Court opinion index
court_opinions.summary: Indexes CourtListener opinions by decision, opinion type and author, using its bulk export.
court_opinions.scope: Includes the complete June 30, 2026 opinions export without its text fields; opinion text is not included.
gaps: Some opinions lack matching decision records because the exports closed at different times.
Author names are source text; only source-linked judges have a resolved author identifier.

court_parentheticals.label: How courts describe cited opinions
court_parentheticals.summary: Preserves a citing court’s own words about another opinion, automatically extracted by CourtListener. These passages can describe a holding, a fact or a procedural point.
court_parentheticals.scope: Includes the complete June 30, 2026 parentheticals export.
gaps: The score is a model estimate, not a human review of the passage or holding.
Several passages can repeat the same point; some links to opinions are unmatched.

crs_reports.label: Congressional Research Service reports
crs_reports.summary: Lists report details supplied by Congress.gov. Updates add new versions while preserving earlier report identities.
crs_reports.scope: Current report versions dated October 22, 1993 onward; the publication date describes that version, not the report’s first issue.
gaps: Report bodies, authors, available formats and related materials are not collected here.

diff_summaries.label: AI bill-change summaries
diff_summaries.summary: Reserved for AI-generated explanations of changes between bill versions. Automatic updates currently leave this feature disabled.
diff_summaries.scope: Intentionally empty under the current processing policy.
gaps: Detailed computed comparisons remain available in the bill comparison tables.

discovery_signals.label: Agency activity spikes
discovery_signals.summary: Highlights changes in recent agency document counts compared with the prior-year monthly baseline. Known removed postings and future dates are excluded.
discovery_signals.scope: A snapshot calculated from collected documents at the stated calculation time, not a historical series or a complete measure of agency activity.
gaps: Adding older records or correcting source dates can produce apparent activity spikes.

docket_attributes.label: Docket details
docket_attributes.summary: Copies additional Regulations.gov docket fields, combining an earlier API capture with full Mirrulations reads and later updates.
docket_attributes.scope: Covers docket records in the Mirrulations mirror.
gaps: Missing source fields remain blank; records can reflect different update times.

dockets.label: Rulemaking dockets
dockets.summary: Collects Regulations.gov dockets through Mirrulations, combining earlier records, selected historical repairs and later updates.
dockets.scope: Covers the accumulated collection, not a fresh census of Regulations.gov.
gaps: The modification date records a source update, not when the docket opened or was collected.

document_attributes.label: Document details
document_attributes.summary: Copies additional Regulations.gov document fields, combining an earlier API capture with full Mirrulations reads and later updates.
document_attributes.scope: Covers document records in the Mirrulations mirror.
gaps: Missing source fields remain blank; records can reflect different update times.

document_citation_reads.label: Selected text citation checks
document_citation_reads.summary: Records completed citation searches in selected text we already hold, including searches that found no citations.
document_citation_reads.scope: Individually selected bill or report sections, comments, lobbying descriptions, communications and extracted court text.
gaps: Texts not selected or whose searches failed or stopped early have no row.
A completed field search does not establish that the whole document was searched.
Report and budget PDF reads are recorded with those documents instead.

document_citations.label: Document citations
document_citations.summary: Combines citations extracted from committee activity reports and budget PDFs with searches of selected text already held in other tables. Earlier findings remain when a new read fails.
document_citations.scope: Accepted activity reports and budget volumes, plus selected bill/report sections, lobbying descriptions, inline comments, communications and court text.
gaps: Select a text version before counting; repeated mentions and retained versions produce separate rows.
No rows can mean the text was never searched. Comment attachments are excluded.
Unresolved targets are not necessarily wrong citations; some links rely on interpreted names.
A missing index comparison means not compared, not absent from the index.

documents.label: Docket documents
documents.summary: Collects Regulations.gov documents through Mirrulations, combining earlier records, selected historical repairs and later updates.
documents.scope: An accumulated collection, not a fresh census. Repairs added metadata and links, not body text; the full comment collection is separate.
gaps: Source dates can be missing, invalid or future; docket links can be missing or unmatched.
A date field alone does not establish submission purpose or the current official deadline.
Removed and moved postings remain; reposts can duplicate records. An unchecked status does not confirm a posting is still available.

fcc_filings.label: FCC filings
fcc_filings.summary: Collects filings from the Federal Communications Commission’s comment system through recent-date updates and selected older proceeding searches, retaining earlier records.
fcc_filings.scope: Covers filings received from August 24, 2026 onward, plus earlier filings from selected proceedings. The newest day is partial; proceeding counts are not complete archive totals.
gaps: Filings released more than a week after receipt can be missed, and later docket assignments can be stale.
Attachment text is available for only a few selected PDFs.

fcc_proceedings.label: FCC proceedings
fcc_proceedings.summary: Reads dated proceedings from the Federal Communications Commission’s comment system, refreshing their closing dates and status on each full read.
fcc_proceedings.scope: Covers proceedings created from 1991 onward, keeping one preferred record per docket name.
gaps: Proceedings without a creation date cannot be reached by the date-based search; unnamed records are also omitted.
Open proceedings can have placeholder closing dates; check the notice for filing deadlines.

fec_account_transfers.label: Reported account transfers
fec_account_transfers.summary: Records transfers and account activity reported in Schedules H3 and H5 of saved electronic filings. Amounts keep their reported signs.
fec_account_transfers.scope: Selected filings only; reporting periods and amendment coverage vary by collection.
gaps: Both sides of a transfer may appear; adding them can double-count the same money.
Review amendments, repeated records, and memo or subtotal flags before calculating totals.
Quality notices flag records without automatically removing them.

fec_agency_mapping_dispositions.label: Agency report processing outcomes
fec_agency_mapping_dispositions.summary: Records which facts from saved agency reports were mapped into tables, left unmapped, or rejected.
fec_agency_mapping_dispositions.scope: Selected XML reports, webpages, and Word documents; a processing log for saved material.
gaps: PDF text processing is deferred.
Complete report history has not been established.

fec_agency_report_documents.label: Agency report document links
fec_agency_report_documents.summary: Lists document links found in saved agency and oversight reports, with the recorded availability of their contents.
fec_agency_report_documents.scope: Selected report and oversight pages; complete report history has not been established.
gaps: A link does not mean the document was downloaded.
PDF text processing is deferred.

fec_agency_report_text.label: Agency report text
fec_agency_report_text.summary: Extracts paragraphs from saved Word reports and supported agency narratives. Narrative text remains text rather than inferred statistics.
fec_agency_report_text.scope: Selected saved reports and supported text sections.
gaps: PDF text processing is deferred.
Complete report history has not been established.

fec_agency_reports.label: Agency report editions
fec_agency_reports.summary: Describes saved Freedom of Information Act reports in XML, oversight webpages, and Word agency reports.
fec_agency_reports.scope: Selected report editions and supported document formats.
gaps: Complete report history has not been established.
PDF text processing is deferred.

fec_allocated_disbursements.label: Reported allocated spending
fec_allocated_disbursements.summary: Reads spending allocations from Schedules H4 and H6 in saved filings and supported Schedule H4 responses from the FEC data service. Amounts keep their reported signs.
fec_allocated_disbursements.scope: Selected filings and saved responses only; periods and amendment coverage vary by collection.
gaps: Allocation totals and their components describe overlapping amounts; keep them separate.
Review amendments, repeated records, and memo or subtotal flags before calculating totals.
Quality notices flag records without automatically removing them.

fec_allocation_bases.label: Reported spending allocation bases
fec_allocation_bases.summary: Records the ratios and supporting bases used to allocate spending in Schedules H1 and H2 of saved filings.
fec_allocation_bases.scope: Selected filings and supported form versions.
gaps: Interpret each ratio with its reported basis and period; these are not spending totals.
Amendments and repeated filings remain separate until reviewed.
Quality notices flag records without automatically removing them.

fec_api_response_controls.label: FEC response counts and limits
fec_api_response_controls.summary: Keeps response counts, page limits, and completeness statements from saved candidate and committee queries to the FEC data service.
fec_api_response_controls.scope: Selected saved responses; these rows describe requests and responses rather than candidates or committees.
gaps: Reported counts and page limits do not prove every page was collected.

fec_audit_findings.label: Reported audit findings
fec_audit_findings.summary: Records findings, categories, and supporting-document references from saved FEC audit case records.
fec_audit_findings.scope: Selected audit records; complete case history has not been established.
gaps: Repeated reports remain separate and may describe different stages of an audit.
Document links do not establish that the contents were downloaded.

fec_bundled_contributions.label: Reported bundled contributions
fec_bundled_contributions.summary: Records identified bundlers and recipients from Schedule A-L and other supported saved filing records. Bulk recipient totals appear separately in reported financial summaries.
fec_bundled_contributions.scope: Selected filing records only; periods and amendment coverage vary by collection.
gaps: Review amendments, repeated records, and memo or attribution flags before calculating totals.
Keep individual records separate from overlapping recipient summaries.
Quality notices flag records without automatically removing them.

fec_candidate_api_observations.label: Candidate data service records
fec_candidate_api_observations.summary: Preserves candidate results as returned by the FEC data service, including repeated appearances and lists within each response.
fec_candidate_api_observations.scope: Selected saved responses, kept separately from the candidate bulk history.
gaps: These records do not select a single current profile for each candidate.
Complete candidate history has not been established.

fec_candidate_history.label: Candidates by election cycle
fec_candidate_history.summary: Rebuilds candidate records from complete official bulk master files for each two-year election cycle. The current cycle’s file is refreshed daily and can change.
fec_candidate_history.scope: Every cycle from 1980 through the current cycle; the reviewed publication covers 1980–2026.
gaps: A candidate can appear in multiple cycles; rows are not a count of distinct people.
The review did not independently compare every row with its original file.

fec_collection_selection.label: Contribution file selections
fec_collection_selection.summary: Records which saved version of individual-contribution data was selected when a main file and files split by date represent overlapping records.
fec_collection_selection.scope: Selected bulk contribution files and their recorded equivalence checks.
gaps: These are file-selection decisions, not additional contributions.
Selection checks do not establish complete FEC history.

fec_collections.label: Saved FEC collections
fec_collections.summary: Describes the scope and outcome of selected FEC queries, files, database exports, and documents. Use these records to identify what was requested and saved.
fec_collections.scope: Selected collections only; supported source types do not prove that every source was collected.
gaps: Bulk directory entries describe files, not the records inside them.
Rows without a profile may describe scope, refusals, or context, not successfully parsed collections.
A refused request does not establish that a source has no records.

fec_committee_history.label: Committees by election cycle
fec_committee_history.summary: Rebuilds committee records from complete official bulk master files for each two-year election cycle. The current cycle’s file is refreshed daily and can change.
fec_committee_history.scope: Every cycle from 1980 through the current cycle; the reviewed publication covers 1980–2026.
gaps: A committee can appear in multiple cycles; rows are not a count of distinct committees.
The review did not independently compare every row with its original file.

fec_committee_master_observations.label: Saved committee master records
fec_committee_master_observations.summary: Preserves committee records from selected saved bulk master files, including repeated appearances across files and snapshots.
fec_committee_master_observations.scope: Selected committee master files, with each file’s cycle and field definitions retained.
gaps: These records do not select a single current committee profile.
Full historical coverage requires checking the selected files.

fec_committee_observations.label: Committee data service records
fec_committee_observations.summary: Preserves committee results from saved FEC data service responses. These records remain separate from the accumulated committee registry and bulk histories.
fec_committee_observations.scope: Selected saved committee queries and response pages.
gaps: Repeated results may describe the same committee at different times.
Complete history and current profiles have not been established.

fec_committees.label: Political committees
fec_committees.summary: The scheduled collector checks the FEC committee registry weekly and recent filers daily. Updated rows replace earlier rows for the same committee; committees absent from newer results remain.
fec_committees.scope: Each Sunday, the collector walks the full registry; daily checks cover the previous seven days of filing activity.

gaps: These checks do not cover all legal titles.
A read date does not establish when the source was last checked for changes.

native_legal_references.label: References in legal text
native_legal_references.summary: Finds legal references and source citations in selected saved regulatory and statutory files. It attempts to link them to records in other selected tables.
native_legal_references.scope: Electronic Code of Federal Regulations Title 1 requested as of August 10, 2026, and U.S. Code Title 1 release 119-103.
gaps: Other titles are outside the documented selection.
A saved-file reread is not a fresh publisher check.
Unmatched, unsupported and unchecked references remain distinct.

nominations.label: Nominations
nominations.summary: Lists nominations and their latest recorded action from saved Congress.gov listing pages. Earlier observations remain as the list changes.
nominations.scope: Distinct nomination records captured for the 119th Congress.
gaps: Repeated or disappearing source records prevent a completeness claim based on page counts.
Nominee details and full action histories are not collected.
Latest-action text does not establish a separately verified confirmation outcome.

org_committee_links.label: Commenter organizations matched to committees
org_committee_links.summary: Matches commenter organization names to Federal Election Commission committee names and shows the commission’s stated sponsor alongside each match.
org_committee_links.scope: Only the small share of comments naming an organization can be matched. Candidate committees and leadership political action committees are excluded.
gaps: Name matches can be wrong; they are not official affiliations. Confidence grades the matching rule, not a measured probability.
A missing link does not establish that no affiliation exists.
Matches can include terminated committees; check the dates and stated sponsor.

press_releases.label: Appropriations press releases
press_releases.summary: Collects House and Senate Appropriations committee publication feeds and infers bill links from release titles and descriptions. Releases remain after they leave a feed.
press_releases.scope: House and Senate Appropriations feeds captured since September 19, 2026, including older items then present. Other committees and earlier feed history are excluded.
gaps: Full release webpages are not collected; Senate matching uses titles only.
Inferred bill links can be wrong; their accuracy has not been measured.
A missing link can mean matching was never attempted or the bill was unavailable.

proceedings.label: Rulemaking proceedings
proceedings.summary: Groups docket, document and Federal Register records into regulatory proceedings, preserving earlier proceeding identities where supported.
proceedings.scope: Covers collected dockets and Federal Register documents without a docket, using source references to connect records.
gaps: These are derived groupings, not official counts of distinct rules.
A shared regulation identifier alone does not combine records into one proceeding.

public_activity_events.label: Changes detected in bill records
public_activity_events.summary: Records changes between successive captures of bill details, versions and summaries. Previously detected changes remain available.
public_activity_events.scope: Bills compared across collection runs from the 108th Congress onward.
gaps: This is not the bill’s complete historical action sequence.
The date a change was detected here can differ from the date it happened.
Earlier legislative stages are recalculated and can differ from values published at the time.

record_issues.label: Daily Congressional Record issues
record_issues.summary: Combines Congress.gov’s issue listings with separately fetched issue details and document links. Earlier captures remain while missing details are added.
record_issues.scope: Listed session volumes for selected Congresses, with up to 1,000 detailed issue reads per run.
gaps: Issue presence does not establish that its full text or articles were downloaded.
Some listed issues may still lack detailed records.
An issue with no chamber section can contain only the Daily Digest.

regulatory_agenda_items.label: Planned regulatory actions
regulatory_agenda_items.summary: Combines Unified Agenda observations with regulation identifiers stated in dockets, documents and Federal Register records.
regulatory_agenda_items.scope: One item per regulation identifier observed in those collected sources, including identifiers not found in the collected agenda editions.
gaps: An identifier describes a planned regulatory action; it does not establish that a rule was finalized.

report_sections.label: Committee report text sections
report_sections.summary: Extracts headings and text blocks from collected committee-report parts. Original headings are preserved as earlier reports are retained and reread.
report_sections.scope: Sections in the report documents we have acquired and successfully read.
gaps: Agency identifiers are unresolved.
HTML text has no inferred page numbers.
Coverage follows the report collection; older records may still await separation into report parts.

roll_call_votes.label: House and Senate roll-call votes
roll_call_votes.summary: Combines official House Clerk and Senate vote files with bill-action references to identify related bills. Each chamber updates independently and retains earlier votes.
roll_call_votes.scope: Regular collection covers the sitting Congress; historical collection is separate. Publisher files reach the 101st Congress, with House files beginning in 1990, its second session.
gaps: Publisher archive range does not establish complete local coverage.
Bill links can conflict; some amendment and procedural votes have no bill link.
Failed updates retain earlier captures; closed-Congress votes are normally kept without repeated source checks.

rule_targets.label: Docket references to regulations
rule_targets.summary: Links dockets to Code of Federal Regulations provisions and regulation identifiers when the collected source records support the reference.
rule_targets.scope: Covers references in collected docket, document and Federal Register records.
gaps: A shared regulation identifier alone does not establish an action-specific link.

rulemaking_lifecycles.label: Rulemaking lifecycles
rulemaking_lifecycles.summary: Pairs proposal, final-rule and withdrawal events for docketed proceedings. Unfinished proceedings remain open through the last day covered by their inputs.
rulemaking_lifecycles.scope: Covers collected docketed proceedings; Federal Register items without dockets are excluded.
gaps: Legacy upload dates can differ from action dates.
Petition notices can serve as proposals, and some final rules remain unmatched across dockets.
One rule can span several dockets, so rows are not distinct rulemakings.

sam_entities.label: Federal entity registrations
sam_entities.summary: Public registrations come from SAM.gov bulk downloads; the collection can also retain selected API results and earlier records. Different registration years are refreshed at different times.
sam_entities.scope: Covers public active registrations dated 1996–2026 and two older registrations from 1949 and 1968, as observed when each year was read.
gaps: This is not a single current census; retained registrations can be older than the latest refresh.
An entity can have several registrations, so its entity identifier alone is not unique.

scorecard_item_links.label: Scorecard links to bills & votes
scorecard_item_links.summary: Matches publisher-scored actions to congressional bills, amendments and votes using exact identifiers.
scorecard_item_links.scope: Links between the scorecard and congressional data versions used to build this table.
gaps: This table counts matched links only. Unresolved, ambiguous and conflicting attempts are in this release’s receipts, outside these row counts. Similar names do not establish a match.
Links may refer to older input data rather than the latest published tables.

scorecard_items.label: Scored bills, votes & actions
scorecard_items.summary: Records the actions each publisher chose to score. Separate actions on the same bill remain separate items.
scorecard_items.scope: Items from selected scorecard editions, collected from data feeds, files, web pages and PDFs.
gaps: Scores and preferred actions express each publisher’s views; scales are not converted for comparison.
The reviewed release reused saved files; it did not fetch new publisher records.
Original source text may be unavailable; some evidence keeps only a source reference and a file fingerprint.

scorecard_member_item_results.label: Results for each scored action
scorecard_member_item_results.summary: Records each person’s result on a scored action, as reported by the publisher. A result can appear without a stated connection to an overall score.
scorecard_member_item_results.scope: Results from selected editions, collected from data feeds, files, web pages and PDFs.
gaps: Scores and preferred actions express each publisher’s views; scales are not converted for comparison.
The reviewed release reused saved files; it did not fetch new publisher records.
Original source text may be unavailable; some evidence keeps only a source reference and a file fingerprint.

scorecard_member_links.label: Scorecard links to members of Congress
scorecard_member_links.summary: Matches people in scorecards to congressional records using exact identifiers and their historical service context.
scorecard_member_links.scope: Links between the scorecard and congressional data versions used to build this table.
gaps: This table counts matched links only. Unresolved, ambiguous and conflicting attempts are in this release’s receipts, outside these row counts. Names alone do not establish a match.
Links may refer to older input data rather than the latest published tables.

scorecard_member_ratings.label: Member scores, grades & ranks
scorecard_member_ratings.summary: Preserves each publisher’s scores, grades and ranks for members. Different types of rating remain separate.
scorecard_member_ratings.scope: Ratings from selected publishers and editions; availability varies by publisher and year.
gaps: Scores and preferred actions express each publisher’s views; scales are not converted for comparison.
Coverage varies by publisher and edition. Incomplete updates can leave older records in place.
Original source text may be unavailable; some evidence keeps only a source reference and a file fingerprint.

scorecard_members.label: People listed in scorecards
scorecard_members.summary: Records the people each publisher lists in an edition, including people it did not grade or chose to exclude.
scorecard_members.scope: People in selected editions; names and context remain as the publisher reported them.
gaps: Coverage varies by publisher and edition. Incomplete updates can leave older records in place.
Original source text may be unavailable; some evidence keeps only a source reference and a file fingerprint.

scorecard_methodologies.label: Scoring rules
scorecard_methodologies.summary: Records publishers’ explanations of how they score members, including the chamber and group each set of rules applies to.
scorecard_methodologies.scope: Rules stated in the collected editions; missing rules are not filled in.
gaps: Coverage varies by publisher and edition. Incomplete updates can leave older records in place.
Original source text may be unavailable; some evidence keeps only a source reference and a file fingerprint.

scorecard_metric_components.label: How scores combine
scorecard_metric_components.summary: Records how smaller measures contribute to an overall measure when a publisher explains that relationship.
scorecard_metric_components.scope: Only relationships stated in the collected editions; most editions do not describe how measures combine.
gaps: An empty table means no such relationships were collected; other editions may contain them.
Original source text may be unavailable; some evidence keeps only a source reference and a file fingerprint.

scorecard_metric_items.label: Actions used in each score
scorecard_metric_items.summary: Links scored actions to the measures they contribute to, using the publisher’s stated scoring rules.
scorecard_metric_items.scope: Only action-to-measure relationships stated by the collected editions.
gaps: Coverage varies by publisher and edition. Incomplete updates can leave older records in place.
Original source text may be unavailable; some evidence keeps only a source reference and a file fingerprint.

scorecard_metrics.label: Score and rating definitions
scorecard_metrics.summary: Records what each publisher measures and the chamber, group and time period the measure applies to.
scorecard_metrics.scope: Measures defined in selected scorecard editions.
gaps: Scores and preferred actions express each publisher’s views; scales are not converted for comparison.
Coverage varies by publisher and edition. Incomplete updates can leave older records in place.
Original source text may be unavailable; some evidence keeps only a source reference and a file fingerprint.

scorecard_publishers.label: Scorecard publishers
scorecard_publishers.summary: Identifies the organizations behind the collected scorecards. Edition records preserve the publisher names used at the time.
scorecard_publishers.scope: Publishers represented in the collected editions, rather than a complete directory of rating organizations.
gaps: Coverage varies by publisher and edition. Incomplete updates can leave older records in place.
Original source text may be unavailable; some evidence keeps only a source reference and a file fingerprint.

scorecards.label: Scorecard editions
scorecards.summary: Collects editions of publishers’ congressional scorecards from data feeds, files, web pages and PDFs. Saved records remain when an update is incomplete.
scorecards.scope: Selected publishers and editions; coverage varies by publisher and year.
gaps: Scores and preferred actions express each publisher’s views; scales are not converted for comparison.
The reviewed release reused saved files; it did not fetch new publisher records.
Original source text may be unavailable; some evidence keeps only a source reference and a file fingerprint.

section_classifications.label: AI bill-section classifications
section_classifications.summary: Reserved for AI-generated classifications of bill sections. Automatic updates currently leave this feature disabled.
section_classifications.scope: Intentionally empty under the current processing policy.
gaps: An empty classification table does not mean the bill text is missing.

section_diff_items.label: Bill comparison details
section_diff_items.summary: Lists the matched sections and changes found by comparing consecutive bill printings. Earlier comparisons remain available as new text arrives.
section_diff_items.scope: Items from comparisons where both bill versions were acquired and successfully read.
gaps: Missing or unreadable versions cannot produce comparisons.
A dollar-amount change flag can reflect an added or removed section, not a changed amount within one.
Amount comparisons exclude floor-amendment annotations.

section_diffs.label: Bill-version comparisons
section_diffs.summary: Compares consecutive printings of each bill using their section structure and text. New comparisons can use previously acquired versions.
section_diffs.scope: Pairs of consecutive versions whose text was both acquired and successfully read.
gaps: Listed versions with missing or unreadable text leave comparison gaps.
Procedural printings can make most text appear removed or readded without a comparable policy change.

senate_expenditures.label: Selected Senate expenditure report pages
senate_expenditures.summary: Extracts tables from Senate expenditure reports distributed by GovInfo, preserving printed cells rather than assuming each row is an individual payment.
senate_expenditures.scope: Reports issued from January 1, 2024 onward; only the first 80 pages of each selected file are read.
gaps: Covers selected offices and sections only, not Senate-wide spending. Member-compensation and mail-allocation sections are outside the page window.
Most rows are multiline text blocks, not itemized payments; summaries can repeat across report parts.
Continuation-page headings can be blank, and some extracted text has interleaved characters.

table3_records.label: U.S. Code Table III records
table3_records.summary: Relates public laws to U.S. Code provisions using the Office of the Law Revision Counsel’s bulk Table III file. This replaces earlier webpage collection while preserving prior data when a download fails.
table3_records.scope: Public laws for Congresses represented in the laws table or explicitly selected. The source file reaches 1789, beyond the Congresses extracted here.
gaps: Other Congresses, private laws and pre-1957 session-law chapters are excluded.
Table III can lag enactment by months and omit records within its stated release.
A published update can retain older data after a failed source download.

treaties.label: Treaty document records
treaties.summary: Combines Congress.gov treaty listings with detailed descriptive records. Earlier captures remain while new details are added.
treaties.scope: Treaty records captured for the 119th Congress.
gaps: Treaty bodies, full action histories and older Congresses are outside reviewed coverage.
Suffixed treaty parts can appear in listings, but their details are not collected.
These records do not independently determine a treaty’s legal or in-force status.

unified_agenda.label: Unified Agenda editions
unified_agenda.summary: Collects semiannual plans for agency regulatory actions from RegInfo.gov’s structured edition files, combining the latest edition with earlier editions.
unified_agenda.scope: Covers readable editions from fall 1995 through the latest collected edition.
gaps: No editions are held for 2004 or spring 2012.
A rule appears once per edition that lists it; repeated rows are observations over time, not additional rules.

usaspending_recipients.label: Federal award recipients
usaspending_recipients.summary: Collects USAspending recipient rankings, combining weekly reads of all recipients with positive awards over the trailing 12 months, daily updates to top recipients and older retained rows.
usaspending_recipients.scope: Covers recipients selected by those reads, not all recipients across federal spending history.
gaps: Parent, child and recipient totals overlap; do not add them together.
Amounts can describe different 12-month periods; older records can lack an observation date.
An absent recipient may still have awards in USAspending.
